## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical, end-to-end data ingestion on GCP with real services (GCS, Cloud Functions, DLP, BigQuery) and emphasizes data privacy, traceability, and environment isolation.

## Key Concepts

- GCS event-driven processing
- Cloud Functions (Python) for finalization logic
- Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for PII handling
- BigQuery partitioned tables and batch loading
- Per-environment isolation (dev/stage/prod)
- Idempotent processing and load manifests
- Cloud Logging with correlation_id for traceability

## Code Example

```javascript
// Cloud Function (pseudo) on finalization
exports.handle = async (event) => {
  const bucket = event.bucket
  const file = event.name
  if (!isValidCSV(file)) return
  const data = readCSV(bucket, file)
  const redacted = await dlpRedact(data)
  writeToBucket(redacted, 'processed/' + file)
  loadBigQuery(redacted)
  log({file, status: 'loaded', correlation_id: generateId()})
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test the DLP masking policy with mock data?
- How would you handle partial failures in the load step and ensure idempotence across retries?
